1.broken: The cook (kubelet) asks the supplier for recipe nginx:doesnotexist — no such recipe, so the dish (Pod) never cooks.
1.fix: Give the head order (Deployment) a real recipe: set image nginx:1.27 — a new dish is cooked.

2.broken: The dish (Pod) gets a wrong cooking instruction (command), so it ends at once and the cook restarts it forever.
2.fix: Fix the Deployment's command to sleep 3600 (kubectl edit deploy) — the dish now stays on the table.

3.broken: The dish (Pod) asks for more CPU than any table has, so the host (Scheduler) finds no seat.
3.fix: Lower the request to cpu=100m (kubectl set resources) — the host seats the dish.

4.broken: The cook (kubelet) at table node01 went home — the service is stopped and not enabled.
4.fix: On node01, systemctl enable --now kubelet — the cook returns, also after every reboot.

5.broken: The cook's (kubelet's) job sheet points to /usr/local/bin/kubelet — nobody is there, so the cook never starts.
5.fix: Change the path back to /usr/bin/kubelet, then systemctl daemon-reload and restart kubelet.

6.broken: The phone number (Service) finds dishes by label, but its selector matches no dish's label.
6.fix: Edit the Service selector to the pods' real label — calls reach the dishes again.

7.broken: The phone number (Service) rings the wrong door: targetPort isn't nginx's port 80.
7.fix: kubectl edit svc backend-svc and set targetPort: 80 — the call reaches the dish.

8.broken: A config change broke the front desk (API server); it can't reach the order book (etcd), so nothing answers.
8.fix: Read crictl logs, fix the bad line in kube-apiserver.yaml — the kubelet restarts the front desk.

9.broken: The host's (Scheduler's) start sheet has a typo: kube-schedulerx. The host can't start, so dish test waits.
9.fix: Fix the typo in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml — the host returns and seats test.

10.broken: A door guard (NetworkPolicy) blocks everyone at the backend's door, so client can't get in.
10.fix: Add another guard rule, allow-client: only pod client may enter, on port 80.

11.broken: The phone book (CoreDNS) is not running, so names can't be turned into numbers (IPs).
11.fix: Bring deploy coredns in kube-system back to 2 replicas — names resolve again.

12.broken: The owner needs a written report: a dish's diary (logs) and who uses the most CPU.
12.fix: Save kubectl logs api to /opt/api.log and the kubectl top answer to its file.

13.broken: Robot staff member deploy-bot (ServiceAccount) has no key card, so it can't touch deployments.
13.fix: Create Role deploy-manager (what the card opens) and RoleBinding giving deploy-bot that card.

14.broken: Robot node-viewer needs a card for the whole restaurant (ClusterRole), to look at all tables (nodes).
14.fix: Create ClusterRole node-reader (get,list nodes) and ClusterRoleBinding node-viewer-binding to node-viewer.

15.broken: The owner wants the Argo CD meal kit (Helm chart) printed as plain recipes, without new menu items (CRDs).
15.fix: helm repo add argocd, then helm template with CRDs turned off; save the output file.

16.broken: The ingress-nginx meal kit (Helm chart) must be installed, changed, then undone.
16.fix: helm install, then helm upgrade with new values, then helm rollback to the old revision.

17.broken: The Kustomize kit cooks 1 copy of kweb; the owner wants 3, without touching deploy.yaml.
17.fix: Add a replicas entry (kweb, count 3) to kustomization.yaml, then kubectl apply -k /root/kust.

18.broken: cert-manager added new menu items (CRDs); the owner needs their list and one field explained.
18.fix: kubectl get crd | grep cert-manager > file; kubectl explain certificate.spec.subject > file.

19.broken: A new table (node) has no stove adapter: cri-dockerd isn't installed or running.
19.fix: dpkg -i cri-dockerd.deb, systemctl enable --now cri-docker, and set the kernel settings.

20.broken: The restaurant has no hallways (CNI), so tables can't talk and stay NotReady.
20.fix: Apply the CNI manifest (e.g. Calico) with the cluster's pod CIDR — the hallways are built.

21.broken: The kitchen runs an old version; every table must move to 1.35.2, one at a time.
21.fix: Drain, kubeadm upgrade, upgrade kubelet, restart, uncordon — control plane first, then node01.

22.broken: The order book (etcd) has no copy; if it's lost, every order is gone.
22.fix: etcdctl snapshot save with the certs; later, snapshot restore into a new data dir.

23.broken: The dishes have no phone number that works from outside the restaurant.
23.fix: Name the container port, then kubectl expose as type NodePort — a number on every table.

24.broken: Guests asking for shop.example.com at the street door have no sign telling them where to go.
24.fix: kubectl create ingress web-ing with rule shop.example.com/ → backend-svc:80.

25.broken: The old street-door sign (Ingress) must be replaced by the newer Gateway system.
25.fix: Create a Gateway (HTTPS listener with the TLS secret) and an HTTPRoute to the same Service.

26.broken: Anyone can walk to the db dishes; only api dishes should enter, on port 80.
26.fix: Create NetworkPolicy db-policy: podSelector app=db, allow from app=api, TCP 80.

27.broken: Room prod has no guard at all — all traffic in and out is allowed.
27.fix: Create default-deny for Ingress and Egress, but allow egress port 53 UDP/TCP to the phone book.

28.broken: The dish's recipe card (ConfigMap) still allows TLSv1.2, and running dishes use the old card.
28.fix: Edit the ConfigMap to TLSv1.3 only, then rollout restart so dishes read the new card.

29.broken: The phone book (CoreDNS) has no entry for api.example.com.
29.fix: Add a rewrite rule to the coredns ConfigMap pointing to backend-svc.web, then restart CoreDNS.

30.broken: A guest in one room (namespace) must look up backend-svc, which lives in room web.
30.fix: nslookup backend-svc.web.svc.cluster.local from a busybox pod; save the output to /root/dns.txt.

31.broken: The dish writes a diary (log file), but no helper reads it out.
31.fix: Add sidecar log-shipper (busybox, tail -f) sharing volume logs at /var/log in both containers.

32.broken: No one adds or removes copies of the web dish when the kitchen gets busy.
32.fix: kubectl autoscale deploy web min 2 max 5 cpu 70%, then set scale-down window 30s.

33.broken: All dishes are equally important, so a key dish can't jump the queue for a table.
33.fix: Create PriorityClass high-priority (highest user value minus 1) and set it on the Deployment.

34.broken: Three web dishes fight over node01's space; some can't get a seat.
34.fix: Scale to 0, split free CPU/memory (keep ~10% spare) by 3, set requests, scale back to 3.

35.broken: Dish api needs its recipe card (ConfigMap) and secret sauce (Secret), but neither exists.
35.fix: Create cm app-cfg and secret db-sec, then give them to pod api as env vars.

36.broken: Table node01 should seat only prod dishes, and the dish must ask for that table.
36.fix: Taint node01 env=prod:NoSchedule; give the pod a matching toleration and nodeSelector env=prod.

37.broken: The web dishes must switch to recipe nginx:1.28, and be able to go back.
37.fix: kubectl set image to 1.28, watch rollout status, then rollout undo to go back.

38.broken: The dish needs a shelf, but there is no store room (PV) and no request slip (PVC).
38.fix: Create PV pv-data (1Gi, /mnt/data), a matching PVC, then a Pod that mounts the PVC.

39.broken: There is no room type (StorageClass) called fast, and it isn't the default.
39.fix: Create StorageClass fast (local-path, WaitForFirstConsumer) and make it the only default.

40.broken: The MariaDB dish was thrown out, but its store room (PV) still holds the data.
40.fix: Write a request slip (PVC) that matches the PV, then recreate the Deployment using it.

101.broken: The cook (kubelet) at table node01 stopped and won't come back after a reboot.
101.fix: ssh node01; systemctl enable --now kubelet — the cook is back, also after reboots.

102.broken: Phone number cart (Service) looks for the wrong label, so it rings no cart dishes.
102.fix: Edit the Service selector to match the cart pods' labels; leave the Deployment alone.

103.broken: Reporter dishes ask for more memory than any table has, so the host can't seat them.
103.fix: kubectl set resources deploy reporter --requests=memory=128Mi — all copies get seats.

104.broken: The cook's health check (liveness probe) knocks on door 8080, but nginx answers on 80.
104.fix: Change the liveness probe port to 80 — the cook stops restarting the dish.

105.broken: Dish legacy-app writes a long diary (logs); the owner wants only the ERROR lines.
105.fix: kubectl logs legacy-app -n ops | grep ERROR > /opt/course/5/errors.txt.

106.broken: The Argo CD meal kit (Helm chart) must be printed as recipes without new menu items (CRDs).
106.fix: helm repo add argocd; helm template version 7.7.3 with CRDs off; save to the file.

107.broken: A table (node) needs the Docker stove adapter cri-dockerd and kernel settings that survive reboots.
107.fix: dpkg -i the .deb, systemctl enable --now cri-docker, write the sysctl file, sysctl --system.

108.broken: The owner needs the list of cert-manager menu items (CRDs) and one field explained.
108.fix: kubectl get crd | grep cert-manager > resources.yaml; kubectl explain certificate.spec.subject > subject.yaml.

109.broken: Robot staff member reporter (ServiceAccount) has no key card to read pods in finance.
109.fix: Create Role pod-reader (get,list,watch pods) and RoleBinding reporter-binding to reporter.

110.broken: Front-end dishes have no named door (port) and no outside phone number.
110.fix: Add container port http 80/tcp, then create NodePort Service front-end-svc to port http.

111.broken: The old street-door sign (Ingress) web must become a Gateway that still speaks HTTPS.
111.fix: Create Gateway web-gateway (443, TLS secret) and an HTTPRoute to the same Service.

112.broken: A deny-all guard blocks frontend from reaching backend; several rule sheets are offered.
112.fix: Read /root/netpol/*.yaml and apply the least open one that still allows frontend → backend:80.

113.broken: Dish busybox-logger has no priority, so it can't jump ahead for a table.
113.fix: Create PriorityClass urgent (highest user value minus 1); patch the Deployment to use it.

114.broken: Nobody adds or removes apache-server copies when the kitchen gets busy.
114.fix: Create HPA apache-server: CPU 50%, min 1, max 4, plus the scale-down stabilization window.

115.broken: No room type (StorageClass) local-fast exists, and another class is the default.
115.fix: Create local-fast (local-path, WaitForFirstConsumer), make it default, remove the default mark elsewhere.

116.broken: MariaDB was thrown out; store room mariadb-pv still holds the data but has no slip.
116.fix: Create PVC mariadb (RWO, 250Mi) matching the PV, then the Deployment that uses it.

201.broken: The cook's (kubelet's) job sheet (systemd drop-in) points to a program path that doesn't exist.
201.fix: Fix the path in the drop-in, systemctl daemon-reload, restart kubelet.

202.broken: A typo in the host's (Scheduler's) manifest keeps it away, so pod stuck gets no table.
202.fix: Fix the typo in kube-scheduler.yaml — the host returns and seats stuck.

203.broken: The phone book (CoreDNS) was switched off — zero replicas — so names don't resolve.
203.fix: Scale coredns back up, then save nslookup kubernetes.default to /root/dns.txt.

204.broken: Analytics dishes ask for a table labeled disktype=ssd, but no table has that label.
204.fix: kubectl label node node01 disktype=ssd — the host now seats them; Deployment untouched.

205.broken: The dish's starter step (init container) waits for recipe card inventory-config, which doesn't exist.
205.fix: kubectl create configmap inventory-config --from-literal=ready=yes — the starter step finishes.

206.broken: The restaurant has no hallways (CNI) that can enforce door guards (NetworkPolicy).
206.fix: Install Calico v3.29.2: tigera-operator, then custom resources with the cluster's pod CIDR.

207.broken: The order book (etcd) has no safety copy.
207.fix: etcdctl snapshot save /opt/backup/etcd-snap.db with the given CA, cert and key.

208.broken: The shop kit (Kustomize base) has no prod version with its own room, name prefix and count.
208.fix: Write overlays/prod: base, namespace shop-prod, namePrefix prod-, replicas; then kubectl apply -k.

209.broken: The podinfo meal kit (Helm chart) isn't installed as release web.
209.fix: helm install web podinfo/podinfo 6.7.1 with 2 replicas, then helm upgrade with the new values.

210.broken: Guests asking for example.org/echo have no sign pointing to the echo Service.

211.broken: Recipe card (ConfigMap) nginx-config still allows TLSv1.2 and can still be changed.
211.fix: Set TLSv1.3 only, make the ConfigMap immutable, rollout restart nginx-static.

212.broken: Anyone can reach the db dishes; only role=api dishes from room api should.
212.fix: NetworkPolicy db-allow-api: namespaceSelector AND podSelector in one from item, TCP 80.

213.broken: Order-app writes a diary (log) but no helper reads it out.
213.fix: Add log-shipper as an init container with restartPolicy: Always, sharing the log volume.

214.broken: Three wordpress dishes fight for node01's space; some can't start.
214.fix: Scale to 0, split node01's free CPU/memory by 3 for app and init containers, scale back.

215.broken: The request slip (PVC) asks for a room type (StorageClass) that doesn't exist.
215.fix: Recreate logs-pvc with storageClassName local-path, then recreate pod log-writer.

216.broken: The app-writer dish needs a shelf, but there's no store room (PV) or slip (PVC).
216.fix: Create PV app-pv (hostPath, manual), PVC app-pvc (500Mi), then Pod app-writer mounting it.

301.broken: The front desk (API server) calls the order book (etcd) on port 2380 instead of 2379.
301.fix: Edit kube-apiserver.yaml: set --etcd-servers back to port 2379 — the front desk answers.

302.broken: The head chef (controller manager) has a wrong file path, so nobody makes the missing dishes.
302.fix: Fix the path in kube-controller-manager.yaml — the chef returns and makes all 3 dishes.

303.broken: The cook's (kubelet's) settings name a certificate file that doesn't exist, so it won't start.
303.fix: Fix clientCAFile in /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml, then restart kubelet.

304.broken: A door guard (NetworkPolicy) blocks calls to the phone book (CoreDNS) on port 53.
304.fix: Add NetworkPolicy allow-dns: egress to the kube-system DNS pods on port 53 UDP and TCP.

305.broken: A bad new recipe (image) left checkout unavailable.
305.fix: kubectl rollout undo deploy checkout, then save the running image to /root/checkout-image.txt.

306.broken: The table (node) lacks the Docker stove adapter cri-dockerd and lasting kernel settings.
306.fix: dpkg -i the .deb; enable --now socket and service; write 99-cri.conf; sysctl --system.

307.broken: The Argo CD meal kit must be printed without CRDs, with its server phone number as NodePort.
307.fix: helm template argo with CRDs off and server.service.type=NodePort, then kubectl apply.

308.broken: The owner needs the cert-manager.io menu items (CRDs) listed, and a new ClusterIssuer created.
308.fix: List CRDs of group cert-manager.io into /root/cm-crds.txt; apply ClusterIssuer selfsigned with selfSigned: {}.

309.broken: The front desk's ID badge (apiserver certificate) needs checking and renewing; a join note is needed.
309.fix: kubeadm certs check-expiration; certs renew apiserver; restart it; kubeadm token create --print-join-command.

310.broken: Guests at gateway shop-gw have no route that checks header x-version or splits traffic.
310.fix: HTTPRoute shop-route: header x-version: v2 → shop-v2; all others split by weight.

311.broken: Guard rule sheets look alike; one wrongly lets in any edge pod OR any gateway pod.
311.fix: Apply the policy with namespace AND pod selector in one from item, plus port 80.

312.broken: Catalog dishes have no phone number, and no per-dish entries in the phone book.
312.fix: Expose catalog-svc (8080→80) and headless catalog-headless (clusterIP None); nslookup both.

313.broken: Nobody adjusts worker copies when CPU or memory gets busy.
313.fix: HPA worker-hpa: min 2, max 6, CPU 60%, memory 70%, with scaleUp and scaleDown policies.

314.broken: Critical jobs can't push lower dishes out of the way to get a table.
314.fix: PriorityClass critical-jobs (highest minus 1, PreemptLowerPriority); patch the Deployment to use it.

315.broken: No room type retain-local exists, and the cache dishes have no store rooms.
315.fix: Create StorageClass retain-local (Retain, expandable), then StatefulSet cache with volumeClaimTemplates.

316.broken: Store room pg-data-pv still holds data but is Released: still tied to an old slip.
316.fix: Remove spec.claimRef from the PV, then create PVC pg-data to bind it.
